name: eirberg-admin
description: A staff-only Eirberg admin workspace for ChatGPT and Codex, connected to the deployed Medusa staging service.

interface.longDescription: An admin workspace for authorized Eirberg staff, connected directly to Eirberg’s deployed MCP service and Medusa staging. The initial integration supports news and homepage banners, with draft previews, reviewed changes and operation receipts. Connect your existing Medusa staging staff account through OAuth after installation. Store access and permitted actions depend on your current Medusa permissions and connection consent. This alpha is for staging tests; installing it does not grant store access.
defaultPrompt: Help me review changes to the Eirberg homepage banners.
